title: The binding of isaac vibe
description: Replaces textures and sounds with TBoI and more
body:
This resourcepack replace textures and a little sounds.
Watch screenshots for review with content.

It was originally intended for me and my friends, but I decided to upload it to modrinth after half a year. I will try to spend my free time on updates.

DM me in discord to suggest your ideas or if you have any questions :)
discord: ```_sanzy_```

Future update plans
1. more items
2. sounds
3. gui
4. some blocks
5. some fixes for old things and bad realisations
6. better modrinth RP's page design
